name: ARA2509
title: Undo left others' changes alone
summary: Per-participant undo reverts only your own change. Fields someone else changed after you keep their value; the undo result lists them under skipped with who changed them.
html:
Per-participant undo reverts only your own change. Fields someone else changed after you keep their value; the undo result lists them under skipped with who changed them.

#Common causes

  • Another participant edited the same field after your change.

#Fixes

  • Nothing, if their change should stand; otherwise set the field yourself.

  • Code: ARA2509

  • Constant: collab::UNDO_PARTIAL

  • Reported by: ara-collab
